title: How the Navajo Nation is governed
text: The Navajo Nation Council has 88 delegates who represent 110 chapters. The nation's three-branch government was established in 1991. Its chapters are organized into five agencies: Chinle, Eastern, Fort Defiance, Shiprock, and Tuba City.
